description: Shower enclosure finder by measured space. Give placement (niche, corner, threewall, walkin) and width_cm (plus depth_cm for corner and threewall). Returns enclosure options per type and shape with category links and sample products. Each product carries metadata.compatibility in the same shape as find_compatible, limited to shower trays that fit both the enclosure and the measured space: status fits = a tray fits as is; fits_after_cut = no exact tray, only a cuttable one shortened to compatibility.cut_to; floor_only = no tray, the enclosure goes on a tiled floor; unknown = data missing, do not claim a fit. A niche tray is never wider than the measured niche. Relay the returned message. An option may have no sample products: use its category links. exact=false means no enclosure has this size and the nearest available size is returned instead: tell the customer.

depth_cm.description: Measured depth in cm; required for corner and threewall.

placement.description: Where the shower goes: niche (between two walls, door only), corner (two walls), threewall (three walls) or walkin (open, glass panel).

width_cm.description: Measured width in cm: niche opening, corner/threewall wall length, walk-in glass width.

name: find_by_space
title: Find By Space
